description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 1903/27 of 25.02.2015 D/S Division, Dehiwala
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcels including amendments to property extents, rights of way, owner names, and succession details for specific land plots across various districts. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
